answer_1.quote: To solve hybrid question answering (HQA), we propose HYBGRAG, driven by insights from our empirical analysis, which has following advantages: 1. Agentic: it refines question routing with selfreflection by our critic module; 2. Adaptive: it solves textual, relational and hybrid questions by our retriever bank; 3. Interpretable: it justifies the decision making with intuitive refinement path; and 4. Effective: it significantly outperforms all the baselines on HQA benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: retrieved documents and generated answers to hybrid questions

answer_2.quote: We use the default evaluation metrics provided by STARK, which are Hit@1, Hit@5, Recall@20 and mean reciprocal rank (MRR), to evaluate the performance of the retrieval task.

answer_3.quote: We use default evaluation metrics with an LLM evaluator to label answers as accurate (1), incorrect/hallucination (-1), or missing (0), yielding Score a .
